title.zh: OKX分阶段上线统一代币化股票现货交易
title.en: OKX rolls out unified tokenized stock spot trading in phases

current_state.zh: OKX 将上线统一代币化股票现货交易对，包括 xSHLD 和 xSQQQ，由 xStocks（Backed Assets）支持，以 USDT 报价 24/7 交易，并支持在 Solana 和 X Layer 上充提。
current_state.en: OKX will list unified tokenized stock spot pairs including xSHLD and xSQQQ, backed by xStocks (Backed Assets), with 24/7 USDT-quoted trading and deposits/withdrawals on Solana and X Layer.

updates.title_zh: OKX 将上线统一代币化股票 xLUNR、xOSCR 等现货交易
updates.title_en: OKX to list Unified Tokenized Stocks xLUNR, xOSCR and more for spot trading
updates.what_changed_zh: OKX 将上线包括 xLUNR 和 xOSCR 在内的统一代币化股票现货交易，将其代币化股票产品扩展至更多标的。
updates.what_changed_en: OKX will list Unified Tokenized Stocks including xLUNR and xOSCR for spot trading, extending its tokenized-equity offering to additional underlyings.
